source: Authored for S03 (Issue #79) from the parser limits in docs/architecture/protocol.md#parser-limits and the containment rule in docs/architecture/connection.md. Not captured from a physical television.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, token, serial, certificate, account or personal identifier. The malformed bodies are deliberately invalid: a truncated JSON object and a frame beyond the 64 KiB frame limit. No host, port or URL appears in any frame.
notes: Malformed and oversized inbound frames are dropped inside the module and the session continues: the television then prompts for approval and connects, so the caller sees AwaitingTvApproval then Ready and no parse exception crosses the seam.
